aggregate.description: Whether Alerts should be grouped if `all` or `any` specified fields match. If `all` is selected, an exact match on every specified field name must occur for Alerts to be grouped. If `any` is selected, Alerts will be grouped when there is an exact match on at least one of the specified fields.

time_window.description: The maximum amount of time allowed between Alerts. Any Alerts arriving greater than `time_window` seconds apart will not be grouped together. This is a rolling time window up to 24 hours and is counted from the most recently grouped alert. The window is extended every time a new alert is added to the group, up to 24 hours (24 hours only applies to single-service settings).
